name: L3Harris Technologies
old_description: L3Harris Telemetry & RF Products is a premier manufacturer of missile and aircraft flight test instrumentation and complete airborne turnkey systems.
about:
L3Harris Technologies, through its Telemetry & RF Products division, is based in Millersville, Maryland. The company describes a century of innovation in aerospace and defense, though a specific founding year for the current entity is not stated. It is a publicly traded corporation (NYSE: LHX) led by President and CEO Sam Mehta, who assumed the role after serving as president of the Space & Mission Systems and Communications & Spectrum Dominance segments.

The division manufactures missile and aircraft flight test instrumentation and complete airborne turnkey systems. Across the broader corporation, L3Harris produces solid rocket motors for programs such as PAC-3 MSE and THAAD, builds missile tracking satellites for the U.S. Space Force, and delivers counter-unmanned systems like VAMPIRE to the U.S. Army. The company reports $21.9 billion in annual revenue, operates in more than 100 countries, and organizes around three strategic segments.

Primary customers include the U.S. Department of Defense, the Missile Defense Agency, the U.S. Space Force, and allied nations. Concrete programs include the Hypersonic and Ballistic Tracking Space Sensor (HBTSS), the Terminal High Altitude Area Defense (THAAD) system, the AEGIS Ballistic Missile Defense System, and the Ground-Based Midcourse Defense System. The company also supports hypersonics development and provides ballistic missile targets through its Coleman Aerospace subsidiary.

L3Harris positions itself as the "Trusted Disruptor," stating that it innovates relentlessly to deliver capability with the speed, passion, and determination that customers demand for their most challenging missions. It emphasizes multi-domain integration across space, air, land, sea, and cyber as a core differentiator.
